violated_contract: A passive memory may be attributed to the account owner only when the whole source transcript identifies exactly one owner speaker cluster. A segment is_user flag or model-authored about=user label cannot establish that authority when owner clustering is absent or ambiguous. Measured passive extraction yielded approximately 81 percent third-party facts, including two-person dialogues whose clusters were both marked as the owner.
canonical_prevention: Derive typed owner evidence from the shared speaker-count primitive and admit owner attribution through one policy. Quote promotion additionally requires the unique owner cluster. Render ambiguous memory transcripts without owner names and gate daily-summary primary-user candidates on cited source evidence.
